structure.MEDHA_STYLE.md: The Medha style guide every contributor and AI assistant follows

sections.title: Working with AI assistants
sections.body:
`MEDHA_STYLE.md` is the single source of truth for how code in this project should look. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini and Windsurf all read it through their own instruction files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `.cursor/rules/`, `.windsurf/rules/`).

The same rules are enforced by `{{ runScript }} check:style` in the pre-commit hook and CI, so off-style code is caught whichever tool wrote it.
